categories.main_business_segments: 3onedata Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial internet communication solutions, focusing on industrial Ethernet switches, embedded industrial Ethernet modules, device networking products, and industrial wireless products. The company serves multiple sectors including smart energy, smart transportation, industrial internet, smart cities, and intelligent manufacturing, offering comprehensive end-to-end industrial internet communication solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies such as the SWOSA9 industrial switch platform, NOS industrial switch operating system, BlueEdge industrial gateway digital application platform, and TSN (Time Sensitive Networking) technology. It employs a combination of in-house R&D and outsourced manufacturing, with key production steps like programming, welding, testing, assembly, and packaging done internally, while PCBA processing is outsourced. The company also integrates advanced technologies like AI, edge computing, 5G, WiFi7, and industrial encryption.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial enterprises in power and new energy, smart mining, rail transit, digital cities, and intelligent manufacturing. The company collaborates with leading industry players such as China CRRC, China Coal Technology, and State Grid. Its products and solutions cater to industrial automation, energy management, transportation infrastructure, and smart city projects domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic presence supported by offices in 21 core cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, and Shanghai. It also actively expands overseas markets through localized sales and service teams, with established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Poland targeting Eastern Europe, and sales channels in Southeast Asia, Middle East, Europe, and Oceania.
categories.supply_chain_position: 3onedata operates mainly in the midstream of the industrial internet communication supply chain, focusing on R&D, design, and production of communication hardware and software solutions. It procures key components such as chips and optical devices from upstream suppliers, assembles and tests products, and delivers integrated solutions downstream to industrial end-users and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in industrial communication technologies including TSN, industrial AI, edge computing, 5G/6G, WiFi7, and industrial control. It invests heavily in R&D (over 20% of revenue), actively participates in industry standard setting, and collaborates with academic institutions to advance core technologies. Strategic initiatives include developing full-stack industrial internet solutions, enhancing product customization, and integrating AI models like DeepSeek for intelligent data processing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of industrial communication products such as switches, gateways, and wireless devices, as well as through providing customized industrial internet solutions and services. The company employs a mixed sales model with direct sales dominating domestically and a combination of direct sales and local agents overseas.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: 3onedata is positioned as a leading domestic provider of industrial internet communication solutions with strong brand recognition and technological capabilities. It competes with both domestic and international industrial communication equipment manufacturers, leveraging its proprietary technologies, multi-industry applications, and comprehensive solution offerings to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 356.8 million, a decrease of 18.79% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 32.8 million, down 69.98%. Despite short-term revenue decline due to macroeconomic and market factors, the company maintains positive cash flow and continues to invest significantly in R&D, indicating a focus on long-term growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: 3onedata emphasizes its comprehensive, fully self-developed industrial internet digital infrastructure platform, offering high reliability, real-time performance, and security tailored to complex industrial environments. Its products feature advanced technologies like TSN and AI integration, modular design, and strong customization capabilities, providing clients with efficient, intelligent, and stable communication solutions that support digital transformation and smart manufacturing.
